[ASSISTANT_SAID] In "How to Fail at Almost Everything and Still Win Big," Adams discusses the concept of "skill stacking," which involves building a diverse set of skills that can be combined in unique and valuable ways.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Having a diverse set of skills can increase value and competitiveness in the job market.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For artists, building a strong skill stack could involve developing skills in technical art, business and marketing, and communication and collaboration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Identifying strong and weak areas in their skill stack could help artists focus on growth and development.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Artists could start by listing their existing skills and considering additional skills to develop, as well as in-demand skills in their field.
